qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: provide benefits to its host is not ¬p_5(x). This means that the relation is using a negation of a 'does not' when if it does not harm or evade defences it means it provide benefits to its host. But p_5(x) would be 'does not provide benefits to its host', then ¬p_5(x) means 'does provide...' but its not any of the given meanings. This is an incorrect mapping, as the FOL uses ¬p_5(x) as 'provides benefits' but p_5(x) is not defined as 'does not provide benefits'. The FOL assumes p_5 means 'does not provide benefits', but that interpretation is not stated, so it's an unjustified assumption and incorrect.
